purpose: Find and confirm exposed credentials only inside assets the acting organization owns or is explicitly authorized to test.

authorization.web_target_source: one organization repository binding resolved server-side
authorization.desktop_target_source: explicit operator-selected local, Git, URL/API, or pasted source

allowed_actions: web: read the one repository bound to the acting organization
desktop: read explicitly selected local files and repository history
desktop: GET explicitly selected website or API text
make bounded non-generating metadata-style credential verification calls
return masked active findings and integrity evidence
desktop: reveal a confirmed active key once from volatile local memory after explicit confirmation
forbidden_actions: web: accept a path, URL, target list, or custom scan payload
accept credentials embedded in target URLs
make destructive, generating, intentionally billable, publishing, sending, or deployment calls

retention.asset_inventory: until an organization-scoped removal workflow is implemented
retention.temporary_keyhunter_bridge: overwritten and unlinked immediately after verification
